That latest correction also explicitly says `svayam-avatarana` is owed the same dissolution into the wire. This does not make the earlier batch-gate episode false: the batch gate did catch unsolved metas, the landing shell did run, and the ledger still records what it did. What changed is the repository's present account of **where that capability belongs**. First the work said a repeated carrier ritual had become an organ. Then it decided that naming a separate organ was itself an unnecessary layer around operations already native to the core. The biographical fact is the sequence of corrections, not whichever architecture happens to be current at the final sentence.
